tasks.title: TDD: Port logs command
tasks.description:
Create `src/commands/logs.ts` porting the logs subcommand from `bin/ralph` lines 260-267.

Write tests FIRST in `test/commands/logs.test.ts`, then implement.

**Behavior to replicate:**
- Look for `$RALPH_DATA_DIR/.ralph_iterations.log`
- If file doesn't exist, print 'No iteration log found.' and return
- If file exists, print its contents to stdout

**Implementation:**
- Accept `dataDir` as parameter
- Use `Bun.file().text()` or `fs.readFileSync` to read the log file
- Print to stdout

**Test approach:**
- Test with missing log file
- Test with existing log file (create fixture)
- Capture stdout and assert output matches file contents
- Register this command in src/index.ts Commander setup
tasks.notes: Created src/commands/logs.ts with runLogs(dataDir). Tests in test/commands/logs.test.ts cover: missing log file prints 'No iteration log found.', existing log file prints contents, no false 'not found' message when file exists. Updated src/index.ts to import and call runLogs instead of stub. Updated index.test.ts: old stub assertion replaced with flexible check (log file exists on the ralph project itself so actual content is printed). All 124 tests pass.

tasks.title: Verify bun build --compile produces working binary
tasks.description:
Integration verification that the compiled binary works end-to-end. This is the final gate for Phase 1.

**Steps:**

1. Run `bun build --compile src/index.ts --outfile dist/ralph` and verify it succeeds.

2. Test the compiled binary directly:
   - `./dist/ralph --version` → should print `ralph 0.1.0`
   - `./dist/ralph --help` → should print help text
   - `./dist/ralph status` → should work (run from ralph's own project root which has .ralph/)
   - `./dist/ralph logs` → should work

3. Test shell fallback from the compiled binary:
   - `./dist/ralph help` → should work (Commander built-in, not fallback)
   - Verify that `RALPH_FORCE_SHELL=1 ./dist/ralph status` delegates to the shell version

4. Test symlink path resolution:
   - Create a temp symlink pointing to `dist/ralph`
   - Run the symlink and verify it can find `lib/` for shell fallback
   - Clean up the temp symlink

5. Run the full test suite: `bun test` — all tests must pass.

6. Do NOT modify `install.sh`. Do NOT update the `~/.local/bin/ralph` symlink. The user will do this manually after validation.

If any step fails, diagnose and fix the issue. The binary must be fully functional before this task is marked complete.
